title: Fix Cloud Migration recovery when Tenant Media is unavailable
summary: Cloud migration recovery now handles Tenant Media read failures gracefully by using a shared try function that logs skipped checks and preserves saved counts, allowing replication to complete and retry instead of aborting.
key_points: Shared read-only try function for media counts prevents replication webhook abort when table access fails
Unavailable counts are logged and skipped rather than causing failure
Previous media counts are preserved across retry attempts
Added regression tests for normal comparisons, unavailable counts, and retry scenarios
No schema or public API changes
quote: If the count is unavailable, log the skipped check, preserve the saved count, and allow completion handling and replication retries to continue.
